name: CachyOS Kernel
description: Pros: an optimized, patched kernel (Clang ThinLTO and AutoFDO, x86-64-v3, the Cachy patchset), EEVDF with sched-ext ready for opt-in schedulers (scx-scheds). Cons: adds the CachyOS repo and signing key, rebuilds your DKMS modules (NVIDIA and the like) per kernel, and tracks a more bleeding-edge kernel. Your stock Arch kernel stays installed as the default, safe fallback: pick it at the boot menu to roll back anytime.

items.name: linux-cachyos
items.summary: The CachyOS kernel: EEVDF with sched-ext, Clang ThinLTO and AutoFDO, the Cachy patchset. Built for x86-64-v3.
